text:
Type: tall narrow white six-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, hallway, dressing area
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white matte painted fiberboard, black slot grips
Colors: white, black grip accents
Shape: slim upright tower of six equal drawers, flush handleless fronts with black cut-out grips at the top edge, flat top, low plinth, clean geometric lines, slim footprint
Feel: clean, tidy, bright, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, white or grey walls, black accents; minimalist or Scandinavian bedrooms
